transcript.text: There's five stages that most newer
entrepreneurs or people who want to
pursue income go through. So the first
is uninformed optimism. So your friend
tells you about this thing they made 10
grand on and you're like that sounds
amazing. You're uninformed but you're
optimistic, right? And then all of a
sudden you get to informed pessimism. So
you get in and then you put your money
in and then it drops and you're like wow
this sucks. And then you know people are
like buy the dip. And so you're like
okay I'm going to I'm going to put more
money in. And so then you get to kind of
stage three which is the value of
despair where you're like oh my god I've
lost so much money. I have no idea
what's what's going on right now. And at
stage three, there's kind of a fork. And
so either people then go, "Well, my
other friend told me about this other
thing." And they jump back to step one.
And then they just funnel through that
loop over and over again. To break
through that that dip, you have to
basically get to stage four, which is
informed optimism. Now you understand
the rules of the game. You understand
the variables at play. And it's not as
good as you thought it was, but you at
least get it. And so from there then you
can get to achievement.
